title: Figures 1-2: metamaterial split ring resonator (SRR) and electric ring resonator (ERR)
description: Figure 1 shows a copper-colored square split ring resonator on a dark substrate with dimensions a0, l, s, w and r, beside a table of cylinder parameters r, s and μr for cylinders 1-10; the caption describes the magnetic split ring resonator unit design on Duroid 5870 substrate (Reference 6). Figure 2, "Example of Another Metamaterial Component: Electric Ring Resonator (ERR)", shows a yellow double-gap resonator pattern on a blue background with E, H and k field axes, noting possible application in "THz and microwave absorbers".
